dialogue.content: 本日はよろしくお願いいたします
dialogue.English: Thank you for coming in today. I look forward to our session.

dialogue.content: こちらこそよろしくお願いします。
dialogue.English: Thank you for having me.

dialogue.content: 15時開始でいいですか？
dialogue.English: Is it okay to start at 3:00 p.m.?

dialogue.content: 時間になりましたら始めさせていただきますね。
dialogue.English: Yes, we'll begin at the scheduled time.

dialogue.content: 了解しました。
dialogue.English: Understood.

dialogue.content: こんにちは、相談員です。
dialogue.English: Hello, I'm the counselor.

dialogue.content: こんにちは
dialogue.English: Hello.

dialogue.content: 本日はどのようなご相談でしょうか？
dialogue.English: What would you like to talk about today?

dialogue.content: 主人と離婚したいのですが、決心がなかなかつかないんです。
dialogue.English: I want to divorce my husband, but I can't quite bring myself to make the final decision.

dialogue.content: 離婚のことで悩まれているのですね・・・
dialogue.English: So you’re struggling with the decision to divorce...

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: 決心がつかないとのことですが、なにか理由などがあるのでしょうか？
dialogue.English: You mentioned it’s hard to decide—are there any particular reasons for that?

dialogue.content: 年齢とか言った方がいいですか？
dialogue.English: Should I mention my age and things like that?

dialogue.content: ありがとうございます。年齢とできればお呼びするお名前も教えていただけますか？
dialogue.English: Thank you. Could you please tell me your age and, if you're comfortable, a name I can call you by?

dialogue.content: ５０歳です。冴子といいます。
dialogue.English: I’m 50. My name is Saeko.

dialogue.content: ありがとうございます。決心がつかないようですが、何か理由などあるのでしょうか？
dialogue.English: Thank you. It sounds like it’s hard to make a decision—are there any particular reasons for that?

dialogue.content: 主人は自営業で共同経営しています。独立してやっていけない事はないのですが、いざとなると不安や怖さが立ちます。
dialogue.English: My husband is self-employed, and we run the business together. It's not that I couldn't manage on my own, but when it comes down to it, I feel anxious and scared.

dialogue.content: 1人で生きていけるかなとか、経済的な事とか。
dialogue.English: Things like, can I make it on my own, and financial matters.

dialogue.content: 先が見えない中での独立は心配ですものね・・・
dialogue.English: It's natural to be worried about going independent when the future is uncertain...

dialogue.content: 子供は成人して、既に独立しています。
dialogue.English: Our children are adults and already independent.

dialogue.content: お子さんは手を離れてはいますが、一人で経済的に心配ということで、離婚をとどまっているかんじなんですね
dialogue.English: So even though your children are grown and on their own, you're holding back from divorce because you're worried about managing financially by yourself. Is that right?

dialogue.content: 夫婦2人きりの生活が春から始まったのですが、何か色々目についてイライラしたり、過去の事を思い出してしまったり。
dialogue.English: Our life as just the two of us started this spring, and I've found myself getting irritated by all sorts of things and remembering things from the past.

dialogue.content: ケンカして、一度マンスリーマンション借りたけど、その時の解放感がすごく良くて。
dialogue.English: We had a fight, and I rented a monthly apartment once. The sense of liberation I felt then was so wonderful.

dialogue.content: うんうん
dialogue.English: Mm-hm.

dialogue.content: 一緒に居てイライラしたり、ストレスがたまっていく生活よりは、離れた方がいいと思って、離婚を考える様になりました。
dialogue.English: I started thinking about divorce because I thought it would be better to be apart than to live a life where I'm constantly irritated and stressed from being together.

dialogue.content: そうだったのですね。イライラしたりするのは一緒にいて嫌ですよね・・・
dialogue.English: I see. It’s hard to be together when you’re feeling so irritated...

dialogue.content: そうなんです
dialogue.English: Exactly.

dialogue.content: 夫さんには離婚したいというお気持ちはお話されているのですか？
dialogue.English: Have you told your husband that you want a divorce?

dialogue.content: まだです。
dialogue.English: Not yet.

dialogue.content: ある程度現実的に決めてから、伝えようかなと。
dialogue.English: I was thinking of telling him after I’ve made some concrete decisions.

dialogue.content: なるほど。気持ちが決まってからでないとフワフワしてしまいますものね
dialogue.English: I understand. Until your mind is made up, things can feel a bit up in the air, can't they?

dialogue.content: マンスリー借りた時は１時的だったけど、離婚となると死ぬまでになるし。
dialogue.English: Renting the monthly apartment was temporary, but a divorce is for the rest of my life.

dialogue.content: 確かに先はまだ長いですよね。。この春からお二人で生活されているようでしたが、その前はこのようなお気持ちにはならなかったのでしょうか？
dialogue.English: It's true, there's still a long road ahead... You said you started living as just a couple this spring. Did you not feel this way before then?

dialogue.content: 子供が小さい時に浮気をされました。
dialogue.English: He had an affair when the children were little.

dialogue.content: 離婚したかったけど、経済的な事や住居環境がよかったので、子供の為を思って、離婚しませんでした。
dialogue.English: I wanted a divorce, but because of our financial situation and good living environment, I didn't go through with it for the sake of the children.

dialogue.content: そうなんですか！それは嫌な思いをされましたね。
dialogue.English: Oh, really? That must have been a very painful experience.

dialogue.content: そうなんです。
dialogue.English: It was.

dialogue.content: さきほどおっしゃていた過去のこととはこの浮気のことですか？
dialogue.English: When you mentioned "things from the past" earlier, were you referring to this affair?

dialogue.content: そうです
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: 家族ぐるみで付き合っていた友達と浮気して
dialogue.English: He had an affair with a friend we were close with as a family.

dialogue.content: うんうん
dialogue.English: Mm-hm.

dialogue.content: 結局謝りもせず、うやむやになり、現在に至ります。
dialogue.English: In the end, he never apologized. It was just swept under the rug, and that's how it's been ever since.

dialogue.content: 離婚もお子さんのことなどを考えてされなかったんですものね。その時の嫌な思いは忘れられないですよね
dialogue.English: And you chose not to divorce because you were thinking of your children and other things. It's impossible to forget such a painful memory, isn't it?

dialogue.content: 過去の事と言えばそれまでかもしれないけど、自分の中では、終わっていないんです。
dialogue.English: People might say it’s in the past, but for me, it isn’t over.

dialogue.content: うやむやのまま今まで過ごしてきたのですから、冴子さんの中では終われないのは当然と思いますよ
dialogue.English: Since it was never properly resolved and you've lived with it all this time, it's perfectly natural that it doesn't feel over for you, Saeko.

dialogue.content: 過去の浮気のことは、夫さんはもう清算されたとお感じなんでしょうかね？
dialogue.English: Do you think your husband feels that the past affair has been settled?

dialogue.content: 結局何も謝罪なしです
dialogue.English: In the end, there was no apology at all.

dialogue.content: 仕事が忙しかったし
dialogue.English: We were busy with work, and...

dialogue.content: うんうん
dialogue.English: Mm-hm.

dialogue.content: 話す時間もなくて。
dialogue.English: ...we never had time to talk.

dialogue.content: そうだったのですね。謝ってももらえてないなら、許せないですよね
dialogue.English: I see. If you never even received an apology, it's understandable that you can't forgive him.

dialogue.content: 長いことずっと心の中でモヤモヤしながら過ごされていたのですね。
dialogue.English: So you've been living with this unsettled feeling in your heart for a very long time.

dialogue.content: 時々掃除をすると、子供が小さい時に描いた絵とか出てきます。その当時は付き合いがあったから、そういうのをみると思い出してしまって。
dialogue.English: Sometimes when I'm cleaning, I'll find drawings my children made when they were little. We were all friends back then, so seeing things like that brings it all back.

dialogue.content: うんうん
dialogue.English: Mm-hm.

dialogue.content: モヤモヤが再発するし。
dialogue.English: And the unease flares up again.

dialogue.content: 今は浮気相手は遠くにいったけど、何かモヤモヤします
dialogue.English: The other woman has moved far away now, but I still feel this lingering unease.

dialogue.content: 昔のこととはいえ今でも忘れられないですよね。。。
dialogue.English: Even though it was a long time ago, it’s not something you can just forget...

dialogue.content: 冴子さんはこの浮気のこともあって離婚したいというお気持ちなんですね
dialogue.English: So this affair is part of the reason you feel you want a divorce.

dialogue.content: どうケリをつければいいのでしょう？
dialogue.English: How can I get some closure?

dialogue.content: 主人の顔をみるとイライラする時もあるし。
dialogue.English: And sometimes, just seeing my husband’s face irritates me.

dialogue.content: 何かこのまま一生を終えると思うと、ゾッとする時がありますね。
dialogue.English: The thought of ending my life like this... sometimes it's horrifying.

dialogue.content: そうですよね。嫌な思いを抱えたままと考えたくないものですよね。
dialogue.English: I understand. No one wants to imagine carrying that pain for the rest of their life.

dialogue.content: そのケリのつけ方が、離婚かなと。
dialogue.English: And I feel that divorce might be the way to get that closure.

dialogue.content: 離婚という難しいお話なんですが、一緒に考えていけたらと思います
dialogue.English: Divorce is a difficult topic, but I’d like us to think it through together.

dialogue.content: スッキリした人生送りたいと思ったりします。
dialogue.English: I just want to live a life that feels clear and unburdened.

dialogue.content: カウンセラーさんからみて、どう思いますか？
dialogue.English: From your perspective as a counselor, what do you think?

dialogue.content: 子供はちょっと驚くかもしれないけど、いい大人だし。
dialogue.English: My children might be a little surprised, but they're grown adults.

dialogue.content: 冴子さんのお気持ちが大切だと思いますよ。もちろん、離婚は一人ではできないので、夫さんとの話合いなども必要とはなるとおもうところではありますが・・・
dialogue.English: I believe your feelings are what's most important, Saeko. Of course, divorce isn't something you can do alone, so discussions with your husband will be necessary...

dialogue.content: 心配なのは、行き先がないのと経済的な事です
dialogue.English: What worries me is not having a place to go and the financial side of things.

dialogue.content: 経済的に心配とさきほどおっしゃっていましたが、離婚したいということで冴子さんは経済的なことの不安がなければいいのでしょうか？
dialogue.English: You mentioned being worried financially earlier. Does that mean if your financial anxiety were gone, you would go ahead with the divorce?

dialogue.content: 生活していかないといけないし。
dialogue.English: I have to make a living, after all.

dialogue.content: そうですよね。生きていくためにはお金が必要になってきますものね。
dialogue.English: That's right. You need money to live, after all.

dialogue.content: 離婚するためにはいろいろと手続きなどが必要となってきますが、そのあたりはなにか調べたりはしていますか？
dialogue.English: Divorce involves various procedures and paperwork. Have you looked into any of that?

dialogue.content: ネット検索する位でまだまだです
dialogue.English: Just some internet searches, so I haven't gotten very far yet.

dialogue.content: なるほど。具体的にはまだどうするかなど調べてはいらっしゃらないのですね。
dialogue.English: I see. So you haven't looked into the specific steps yet.

dialogue.content: 弁護士さん立てるのも結構お金いるみたいだし。
dialogue.English: And it seems like hiring a lawyer costs a lot of money, too.

dialogue.content: うんうん
dialogue.English: Mm-hm.

dialogue.content: 住居探しとか引っ越し代とか考えると踏ん切りがつきにくい。でも気持はしんどい
dialogue.English: Thinking about finding a place to live and paying for moving costs makes it hard to commit. But emotionally, it's very tough.

dialogue.content: そうですよね。いろいろとお金がかかってきますから、金銭面だけでも頭痛いですよね・・・
dialogue.English: I understand. It all adds up, so the financial side alone is enough to be a headache...

dialogue.content: しんどいから離れたいけど、現実面が踏ん切りつかずでイライラ。
dialogue.English: It's tough, so I want to leave, but the practicalities make it hard to take the plunge, and it's frustrating.

dialogue.content: 考えすぎてしまってイライラな気持ちですよね・・・お子さんなどにはご相談されましたか？
dialogue.English: It's frustrating when you overthink everything... Have you talked to your children about any of this?

dialogue.content: 言えてないです
dialogue.English: I haven't been able to tell them.

dialogue.content: 子供は子供の人生があるから。
dialogue.English: My children have their own lives to live.

dialogue.content: お一人で悩まれていたのですね。なかなかどうしていいのかわからなくなってしまいますよね
dialogue.English: So you've been struggling with this all on your own. It's easy to get to a point where you just don't know what to do, isn't it?

dialogue.content: だから、ここへ来ました
dialogue.English: That’s why I came here.

dialogue.content: そうだったのですね。少しでもお手伝いできるように、一緒に考えていきましょうね
dialogue.English: I see. Let's think this through together, so I can help in any way I can.

dialogue.content: 専門家の先生に聞いたら、何か聞けるかなと思ったので。
dialogue.English: I thought if I talked to a professional, I might be able to get some insight.

dialogue.content: 今迄の話を聞いて、どう思いますか？
dialogue.English: Having heard my story so far, what do you think?

dialogue.content: いろんな情報を知るチャンスですものね。
dialogue.English: It's certainly a good opportunity to gather information.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: 冴子さん一人で悩まれていて何かお手伝いができればいいと思いました。
dialogue.English: Hearing that you’ve been struggling with this on your own, I want to help in any way I can.

dialogue.content: 少しお話まとめもよろしいでしょうか？
dialogue.English: Would it be alright if I summarize what we've talked about so far?

dialogue.content: メンタル面で何かアドバイスとかいただければありがたいです。
dialogue.English: I'd be grateful for any advice you have on the mental aspect of this.

dialogue.content: お願いします。
dialogue.English: Yes, please.

dialogue.content: 冴子さんは夫さんと離婚されたいと悩んでいらっしゃいます。
dialogue.English: Saeko, you're struggling with the desire to divorce your husband.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: 自営業で共同経営されていて、今までとても忙しく働いてこられました。お子さんは今独立して、春から夫婦二人で暮らしていらっしゃいます
dialogue.English: You and your husband run a business together and have worked very hard. Your children are independent now, and since this spring, you've been living together as just a couple.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: 夫さんの過去の浮気や何かと目に付くことがありイライラしてしまうこともあって、喧嘩をしたときに一人で過ごされたときの解放感もあり離婚されたいと思っています
dialogue.English: You want a divorce because of lingering irritation from your husband's past affair and other things you've noticed, and also because you recall the sense of freedom you felt when you lived alone after a fight.

dialogue.content: その通りです
dialogue.English: That’s exactly right.

dialogue.content: このまま一生を嫌な思いを抱えたまま夫さんと過ごすのは嫌と思い離婚を考えてはいらっしゃいますが、経済的な面などが心配で踏ん切りがつきません
dialogue.English: You're considering divorce because you don't want to spend the rest of your life with your husband while holding onto these painful feelings, but you can't take the final step because of financial and other practical concerns.

dialogue.content: このようなかんじでしょうか？
dialogue.English: Does that sound about right?

dialogue.content: すごくまとめて下さってありがとうございます
dialogue.English: Thank you so much for summarizing it so well.

dialogue.content: すぐすぐは無理だと思うんです。
dialogue.English: I don't think it's possible to do it right away.

dialogue.content: すぐにはいろいろと厳しいですよね・・・お一人で住むところや経済的なことがクリアできれば離婚しようというかんじよろしいでしょうか？
dialogue.English: It's difficult to do everything at once, isn't it... So, is it fair to say that if you could sort out a place to live and your finances, you would proceed with the divorce?

dialogue.content: そうです
dialogue.English: Yes, that's right.

dialogue.content: それまでのモチベーションというか、気持の持ち方ってありますか？
dialogue.English: Until then, is there a way to stay motivated? Or rather, how should I manage my mindset?

dialogue.content: 金銭的なことがほとんどだと思いますが、そこが何とかなれば離婚できそうですね。
dialogue.English: It seems to be mostly about the financial side of things. If that can be managed, a divorce seems possible for you.

dialogue.content: ええ
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: 離婚する前のお気持ち？それとも夫さんと一緒に過ごすお気持ちでしょうか？
dialogue.English: Are you asking about your mindset for the period leading up to the divorce? Or your mindset for how to live with your husband in the meantime?

dialogue.content: 後の方です
dialogue.English: The latter.

dialogue.content: モヤモヤしながら過ごすの、しんどいので。
dialogue.English: Because it's tough living with this lingering unease.

dialogue.content: そうですよね。しばらくは一緒に生活しなければならないですものね。嫌な思いを抱えていてはイライラは募りますよね。
dialogue.English: I understand. You'll have to live together for a while longer, after all. Holding onto these negative feelings will only make the irritation grow, won't it?

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: 今は自宅ではずっと一緒の時間を過ごされているのですか？
dialogue.English: Are you spending most of your time together at home these days?

dialogue.content: 出来るだけ離れたいけど、向こうが色々言ってきます
dialogue.English: I want to keep my distance as much as possible, but he keeps trying to talk to me about various things.

dialogue.content: 食事の事とか家の事とか。
dialogue.English: About things like meals or household matters.

dialogue.content: 夫さんは冴子さんのお気持ちまだ知らないのですものね。。。
dialogue.English: Your husband doesn’t know how you feel yet, of course...

dialogue.content: まずは夫さんに少し離婚したいお気持ちを話してみてはいかがでしょう？
dialogue.English: As a first step, how would you feel about sharing a little of your desire for a divorce with your husband?

dialogue.content: 責められないかというのもあります。
dialogue.English: There's also the fear that I'll be blamed.

dialogue.content: ちょっと短気なので。
dialogue.English: He’s a bit short-tempered.

dialogue.content: 喧嘩した時は勢いで出られたけども
dialogue.English: When we fought, I was able to leave in the heat of the moment, but...

dialogue.content: 冷静に話が出来るかどうか。
dialogue.English: I don't know if we'll be able to discuss it calmly.

dialogue.content: 怒りだされても困りますよね。。。直接言うと怒るのであれば、手紙、メールなどでも伝えられますが。。。
dialogue.English: It would be difficult if he were to get angry... If you think speaking to him directly would make him angry, you could also convey your feelings in a letter or an email...

dialogue.content: 大丈夫でしょうか？
dialogue.English: Do you think that would be okay?

dialogue.content: 冴子さんはあまり伝えたくないかんじですよね。夫さんの行動がどうでるのかわからないというかんじですものね
dialogue.English: It sounds like you’re hesitant to tell him. It makes sense, since you don't know how he will react.

dialogue.content: そうなんです
dialogue.English: Exactly.

dialogue.content: ぐるぐる回ってますね。
dialogue.English: I'm just going around in circles.

dialogue.content: 自宅内ではどのように生活されていますか？例えば、部屋は一緒とか。寝るところは違うとか。ごはん以外は会わないとか。
dialogue.English: How do you manage things at home? For example, do you share a room? Do you sleep in different places? Do you only see each other for meals?

dialogue.content: 寝室は別です。
dialogue.English: We have separate bedrooms.

dialogue.content: そうなんですね。一緒にいる時間をなるべく減らすようにできるといいですが、お仕事も一緒となると厳しいですよね。。。
dialogue.English: I see. It would be good if you could reduce the time you spend together, but that must be difficult since you also work together...

dialogue.content: ご飯が終わると、私は2階・主人は1階で過ごす。
dialogue.English: After we eat, I go upstairs and my husband stays downstairs.

dialogue.content: 減らしているけど、スッキリした方がいいのかと思っています
dialogue.English: I am reducing our time together, but I'm starting to think it would be better to make a clean break.

dialogue.content: そうだったのですね。あまり顔を合わさないようにできればいいですよね。冴子さんは夫さんと離婚するまではどうしたいと思いますか？
dialogue.English: I see. It would be good if you could avoid seeing each other too much. Saeko, what would you like to do in the time leading up to a divorce?

dialogue.content: 住む所が別に確保できれば、別居したいと思っています
dialogue.English: If I can secure a separate place to live, I would like to begin a separation.

dialogue.content: 同じ空間にいる事がしんどくなる事もあるから
dialogue.English: Because sometimes it's just too hard to be in the same space.

dialogue.content: そうですよね。なるべくなら一緒にいないほうがいいですものね。例えば、マンスリーマンションを借りてみる。またはお子さんのところに少しの間だけお世話になってみるというのはどうなんでしょう？
dialogue.English: That makes sense. It's better not to be together if you can avoid it. For example, what about renting a monthly apartment again, or perhaps staying with one of your children for a short time?

dialogue.content: 理由がうまくつけばいいけど…
dialogue.English: If I could just come up with a good reason...

dialogue.content: マンスリーから帰った時、まあまあネチネチ言われたので。
dialogue.English: Because when I came back from the monthly apartment, he nagged me quite a bit.

dialogue.content: でも終わらせたいんだし
dialogue.English: But I really do want to end this.

dialogue.content: なるほど。でも、別居したい理由は一つですよね。理由はストレートに言うのはダメなんでしょうか？
dialogue.English: I see. But there’s really only one reason you want to separate, isn't there? Would it be out of the question to state that reason directly?

dialogue.content: 足を引っ張られないでしょうか？
dialogue.English: Won't he try to hold me back?

dialogue.content: 冴子さんの離婚したいという気持ちが揺るがなければ、きっと引っ張られても平気のようなかんじがいたします。冴子さんの離婚はどのくらいしたいとお考えでしょうか？
dialogue.English: If your desire for a divorce is unwavering, I feel that you'll be able to stand firm even if he tries to hold you back. How strong is your desire for a divorce?

dialogue.content: どの位…
dialogue.English: How strong...

dialogue.content: いますぐ・・それとも、あと数年後・・・いろいろとお気持ちはあると思います。
dialogue.English: Right away... or maybe in a few years... I'm sure you have various feelings about the timing.

dialogue.content: 準備が出来次第という所でしょうか。
dialogue.English: I suppose it would be as soon as I'm prepared.

dialogue.content: 気持が先走って、現実が何も出来ていない感じです、今は。
dialogue.English: Right now, it feels like my feelings are getting ahead of me, and I haven't been able to do anything concrete yet.

dialogue.content: ずっと嫌な思いを抱えながら子育てとお仕事を頑張ってこられた冴子さん。本当にずっと頑張ってこられたことと思います。
dialogue.English: Saeko, you've worked so hard raising your children and managing the business, all while carrying this painful feeling for so long. I can only imagine how hard you've been working all this time.

dialogue.content: ありがとうございます。
dialogue.English: Thank you.

dialogue.content: 離婚のことまだ先の話かもしれませんが、嫌なお気持ちを忘れられず今まで苦しんでいらっしゃたので、そろそろ夫さんとのけじめをつけて嫌なお気持ちから解放されてもいいのかと感じます
dialogue.English: The divorce might still be a ways off, but you've suffered for so long, unable to forget these painful feelings. I feel that it might be time for you to draw a line with your husband and free yourself from that burden.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: 役所など無料で離婚相談できる場所もあることをご存じでしょうか？
dialogue.English: Are you aware that there are places, like local government offices, where you can get free consultations about divorce?

dialogue.content: 聞いた事はあります
dialogue.English: I've heard of them.

dialogue.content: 別居の話も含めて一度ご相談されてもいいのかなあと思いました。
dialogue.English: I was just thinking it might be a good idea to consult with them, including about the possibility of a separation.

dialogue.content: そこへ相談したら、少しはモヤモヤしたり、気持ちも落ち着くでしょうか？
dialogue.English: If I consult with them, do you think this unsettled feeling might lessen, and I'll be able to feel calmer?

dialogue.content: ご自宅の近くであれば、夫さんに知らない間に相談できますし、もしかしたらいい答えがみつかるかもしれないですよ。
dialogue.English: If there's one near your home, you could consult them without your husband knowing, and you might find a good solution.

dialogue.content: 知られないのはいいですね。
dialogue.English: It's good that he wouldn't have to know.

dialogue.content: いってみようかな
dialogue.English: Maybe I'll give it a try.

dialogue.content: モヤモヤは夫さんと一緒にいることでなるのであれば、少し距離をおくというのもいいのかもしれないですよね
dialogue.English: If this feeling of unease comes from being with your husband, then putting some distance between you might be a good idea.

dialogue.content: 別居したらわかってくれるかもしれないですね。
dialogue.English: If we separate, he might finally understand.

dialogue.content: 無理にではありませんが、少しでも気楽に話せる場所が近くにあるだけでもいいのかと思いました。
dialogue.English: I'm not pressuring you, but I thought it might be helpful just knowing there's a place nearby where you can talk freely.

dialogue.content: そうかもしれないですね
dialogue.English: You may be right.

dialogue.content: 誰か話せる人がいると、大分違う気がします
dialogue.English: I feel like having someone to talk to makes a huge difference.

dialogue.content: すぐには解決しないかもしれないですが、冴子さんのお気持ちが話せる場所を見つけられたらいいと思います
dialogue.English: It might not be resolved right away, but I think it would be wonderful if you could find a place where you can talk about your feelings, Saeko.

dialogue.content: 本日はお話されてみていかがでしたか？
dialogue.English: How are you feeling after our talk today?

dialogue.content: そうですね。場所も含め、探してみます。
dialogue.English: Let's see. Yes, I'll look into it, including finding a place.

dialogue.content: 何かちょっとホッとしました。
dialogue.English: I feel a bit relieved.

dialogue.content: 行き詰まった感じがしていたけど、道が開けた感じもします
dialogue.English: I felt like I was at a dead end, but now it feels like a path has opened up.

dialogue.content: また相談に来ていいですか？
dialogue.English: Is it okay if I come back for another session?

dialogue.content: 少しでも冴子さんのお気持ちが軽くなるお手伝いができたこと嬉しくおもいます。これから先、お一人で抱えることなく無理なさらずにお過ごしくださいね。もちろん、またお話しにきてくださいね。
dialogue.English: I'm so glad I could help lighten your burden, even just a little. From now on, please don't try to carry this all by yourself, and don't push yourself too hard. And of course, you are always welcome to come and talk again.

dialogue.content: ありがとうございます🙇
dialogue.English: Thank you. 🙇

dialogue.content: 本日はお話聴かせていただきありがとうございました。これで、ご相談終了とあせていただきますね。
dialogue.English: Thank you for sharing your story with me today. We'll conclude our session here.

dialogue.content: はい。ありがとうございました。
dialogue.English: Yes. Thank you very much.

dialogue.content: 本日はありがとうございました
dialogue.English: Thank you for your time today.

dialogue.content: こちらこそありがとうございました。
dialogue.English: Thank you as well.

dialogue.content: （ありがとうございました。これでロールプレイ終了いますね）
dialogue.English: (Thank you. That concludes the role-play.)

dialogue.content: 了解しました
dialogue.English: Understood.

dialogue.content: （それでは、失礼いたします）
dialogue.English: (Well then, excuse me.)

dialogue.content: ありがとうございました。
dialogue.English: Thank you very much.
